lines.text: Zion's righteousness will shine like a bright light, and she will be a crown of glory in the LORD's hand.
Zion will be called Hephzibah and her land Beulah, because the LORD delights in her and her land will be His bride.
Watchmen are posted on the walls of Samaria, and those who call on the LORD must give Him no rest.
The LORD swears that foreigners will never again take Zion's grain, and the people are told to raise a banner for the armies.
The LORD proclaims to the ends of the earth that Zion's Savior comes, and she will be called Sought Out.
